name: tracker-hygiene
why: Issue bodies are the only channel between three parallel worktrees. An agent that finds a spec wrong and leaves it wrong makes the next agent re-derive it.
prompt: While implementing an issue you discover the pinned RomM contract in server/contract/ returns a field the issue's Design notes say does not exist, and a second open issue is written on the same wrong assumption. What do you do, before you open your PR? Answer in a short list. Change nothing.
